summary: iter313 P0 FINAL — Save-as-Draft across all 5 listing wizards + Drafts dashboard. Last iteration (iter258) had Features 4 (Vehicle) and 5 (Multi-Lot Vehicle) BLOCKED; main agent applied 3 fixes (SellerDrafts URL mapping → /vehicle-multi-lot/create, seeded approved vehicle_sellers record for testdealer, replaced wizard-state mutation with separate universalDraftId state). This regression run confirms ALL 11 features pass end-to-end. Vehicle and Multi-Lot Vehicle Save-as-Draft both fire POST /api/drafts/save → 200 with draft_id. Multi-lot wizard NO LONGER crashes — event-title-input remains rendered after save. Resume Multi-Lot Draft now correctly navigates to /vehicle-multi-lot/create?draft_id=X (NOT the old wrong /vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create) and hydrates the event title from the draft payload. Idempotency confirmed (2 clicks → same draft_id 5179a753-59d4-4420-b93f-7df5d11abc2d).

issues: Cookie Consent banner ('Consentement aux temoins' / 'Cookie Consent') reappears on every page-load despite localStorage.bidvex_cookie_consent={'version':1,'accepted':true} being set. Same issue noted in iter257 and iter258. Banner is non-blocking (force-click bypasses it) but visually overlaps the bottom-right of cards and toasts. Likely the banner mount logic isn't reading the localStorage flag, OR the JSON shape it expects differs from {version:1, accepted:true}.

FEATURE 4 Vehicle Save-as-Draft (NEW PASS — was BLOCKED in iter258): testdealer no longer redirected to /vehicle-auctions/seller/register because vehicle_sellers approved record was inserted. [data-testid='save-as-draft-btn-vehicle'] present in DOM; click → POST /api/drafts/save → 200.

FEATURE 5 Multi-Lot Vehicle Save-as-Draft (NEW PASS — was 404 in iter258): /vehicle-multi-lot/create renders the event-form (event-title-input present, no error boundary, no 404). Click [data-testid='save-as-draft-btn-multi_lot_vehicle'] → POST /api/drafts/save → 200 with draft_id=0426759c-1b5f-41db-ab0d-fe0b124a17aa. After save the wizard DID NOT crash — event-title-input still present, no 'Une erreur inattendue', no LotWizard malformed mount.
FEATURE 6 Drafts sub-tab (verified iter258 + spot-checked here): 4 multi-lot drafts rendered with Reprendre/Supprimer.

FEATURE 7 Resume Multi-Lot Draft (NEW PASS — fixed URL mapping): click [data-testid='edit-draft-0426759c-...'] navigates to https://prod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com/vehicle-multi-lot/create?draft_id=0426759c-1b5f-41db-ab0d-fe0b124a17aa (NOT the broken /vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create from iter258). event-title-input hydrated to 'iter313 Multi-Lot Final'. No error boundary on resume.
FEATURE 9 Delete Draft (verified iter258 + 7 dealer drafts deleted via API in this run).

FEATURE 11 Idempotency (NEW PASS, regression target): testseller @ /create-listing fills #title='iter313 Idempotency Test', clicks [data-testid='save-as-draft-btn-marketplace'] twice with 3s delay. Click 1 → 200, draft_id=5179a753-59d4-4420-b93f-7df5d11abc2d. Click 2 → 200, draft_id=5179a753-59d4-4420-b93f-7df5d11abc2d (SAME id — backend updated the same row, no second draft created). Toast 'Draft saved (expires in 30 days).' shown.
Portal mount z-[90] (re-verified): floating Save-as-Draft button remains clickable above the TaxInterviewModal overlay on /create-listing.

This validates the iter313 architectural choice to keep wizard state independent from the universal draft id.
